title: Vowel sandhi
ask: A word ends in one vowel. The next word starts with another vowel. The two vowels join. Pick two vowels and predict the join.

blocks.prompt: What do the two vowels become?
blocks.why: Say why, in one line, before you lock in.

blocks.text: **{join.name}** (Aṣṭādhyāyī {join.sutra}). {join.why} Now turn a wheel. Find a pair where this rule stops and another rule starts.

sandhi.name: savarṇa dīrgha
sandhi.why: Two vowels of the same kind become one long vowel.

sandhi.name: guṇa
sandhi.why: a or ā before i or ī gives the guṇa vowel e.

sandhi.name: guṇa
sandhi.why: a or ā before u or ū gives the guṇa vowel o.

sandhi.name: guṇa
sandhi.why: a or ā before ṛ gives ar.

sandhi.name: vṛddhi
sandhi.why: a or ā before e or ai gives the vṛddhi vowel ai.

sandhi.name: vṛddhi
sandhi.why: a or ā before o or au gives the vṛddhi vowel au.

sandhi.name: yaṇ
sandhi.why: i or ī before an unlike vowel becomes y.

sandhi.name: yaṇ
sandhi.why: u or ū before an unlike vowel becomes v.

sandhi.name: yaṇ
sandhi.why: ṛ before an unlike vowel becomes r.

sandhi.name: pūrvarūpa
sandhi.why: A short a after a final e merges into it. The mark ’ (avagraha) shows the lost a.

sandhi.name: pūrvarūpa
sandhi.why: A short a after a final o merges into it. The mark ’ (avagraha) shows the lost a.

sandhi.name: ayādi
sandhi.why: e before a vowel becomes ay. At a word end the y often drops (8.3.19).

sandhi.name: ayādi
sandhi.why: ai before a vowel becomes āy. At a word end the y often drops (8.3.19).

sandhi.name: ayādi
sandhi.why: o before a vowel becomes av. At a word end the v often drops (8.3.19).

sandhi.name: ayādi
sandhi.why: au before a vowel becomes āv.
